note: Exactly four selectable human personas are offered by the persona selector. The service identities below are organizational bindings - accountable owners, custodians, the shared delegate, the cross-domain governance routing identity and a second applicant identity used for record-scope checks. A service identity is never selectable. Every grant is explicit: a role label never authorizes an action and a client-supplied role field is never trusted. Administrator configuration access carries no permit approval.

roles.label: Applicant
roles.boundary: Own authorized profile and case contributions only.

roles.label: Intake Clerk
roles.boundary: Delegated intake actions; no permit approval from this role.

roles.label: Domain Steward
roles.boundary: Delegated issue review and corrections within explicit domain/action scope.

roles.label: Domain MDM Steward
roles.boundary: Explicitly granted registry-link decisions for specified entity domains.

roles.label: Accountable Data Owner
roles.boundary: Policy and dispute decisions; no automatic source or case write permission.

roles.label: Permit Reviewer
roles.boundary: Current-version application decisions within delegated scope.

roles.label: Issuing Officer
roles.boundary: Separate permit issuance permission; prerequisites checked by server.

roles.label: Finance
roles.boundary: Authorized financial actions; distinct receipt and allocation permissions.

roles.label: Administrator
roles.boundary: Configuration and access management; no implicit business approval.

roles.label: Auditor
roles.boundary: Read permitted audit evidence; no business mutation permission.

roles.label: System Custodian
roles.boundary: Technical operation and integration recovery, not business meaning.

roles.label: Governance Lead
roles.boundary: Cross-domain ownership/authority dispute routing and assignments.

roles.label: Intake agent (service identity)
roles.boundary: Reads received applications, proposes values and links, and routes a case to early resolution or to review. It never decides.

roles.label: Adjudication agent (service identity)
roles.boundary: Evaluates the published rules of a permit type and recommends an outcome. It never decides.

personas.responsibility: Manages their own authorized profile and case contributions.

personas.label: Permit Reviewer
personas.responsibility: Records permit decisions and performs the separate issuance action.
personas.permission_resolution: explicit_server_permission_grants; never trust role strings in a client request

personas.label: City Administrator
personas.responsibility: Maintains configuration, assignments, authority policy, finance and audit evidence. Configuration access carries no permit approval.
